title: Lake Tahoe Lakeside Bike Rental
includes: High-quality bike rental for the day
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Rescheduling is available in the event of inclement weather
Infants must be at least 6 months old and able to sit up to use a baby seat or bike trailer
Children age 4-11 can use kid bikes or Tagalongs
Comfortable shoes and clothes, water and sunscreen are recommended
Helmets are provided and recommended, though not required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Lake Tahoe’s stunning North Shore on a relaxed, self-guided bike ride designed for all skill levels. Pick up your bike at the Hyatt Regency in Incline Village, where our team ensures a perfect fit and gives a quick safety overview. Once you're set, pedal out on your own to enjoy crystal-clear lake views, quiet lakeside paths, and some of Tahoe’s most scenic photo spots.
